# DIO/ODI Reference Model

> Canonical machine-readable reference layer for Digital Identity Optimization (DIO) and Ontology of Digital Identity (ODI), maintained by Daniel Beránek.

## Versions

- Reference Model release: 0.3.1
- Reference Vocabulary: 0.1.0
- Archived release DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23290683
- Previous archived release: v0.3.0 — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23289615
- Earlier archived release: v0.2.0 — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23282752

## Canonical vocabulary

- Namespace document: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/dio-odi/
- Canonical namespace: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/dio-odi/#
- Turtle / SKOS: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/vocabulary/dio-odi-skos.ttl
- JSON-LD: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/vocabulary/dio-odi.jsonld
- Human-readable terminology: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/docs/terminology.md
- Concept-to-source map: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/docs/source-map.md
- Concept map: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/docs/concept-map.svg

## Derived application mappings

Derived mappings are not part of the canonical DIO/ODI Reference Vocabulary. They apply vocabulary concepts to external technical or analytical domains without modifying canonical definitions or relations.

- Application Mappings index: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/
- Application Mapping: DIO Reconstruction Failure Modes × RAG Pipeline: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/rag-pipeline/
  - Source Markdown: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/rag-pipeline-mapping.md
  - JSON-LD: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/rag-pipeline-mapping.jsonld
  - JSON-LD introduced in: Reference Model v0.3.1
  - Turtle RDF: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/rag-pipeline-mapping.ttl
  - Turtle RDF introduced in: Reference Model v0.3.1
  - Introduced in: Reference Model v0.2.0
  - Included in: Reference Model v0.3.1
- Application Mapping: HEM Heterogeneity Taxonomy × DIO Reconstruction Consequences: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/hem-dio/
  - Source Markdown: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/hem-dio-mapping.md
  - JSON-LD: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/hem-dio-mapping.jsonld
  - Conceptual bridge SVG: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/hem-dio/bridge.svg
  - External HEM source DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.datak.2026.102575
  - Introduced in: Reference Model v0.3.0
  - Included in: Reference Model v0.3.1
  - Turtle RDF: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/hem-dio-mapping.ttl
  - Turtle RDF introduced in: Reference Model v0.3.1
